listing.name: CuratedShips
listing.summary: This mod adds some ships focused on fitting in with the vanilla game.
listing.aiSummary: Adds several custom ships designed to fit seamlessly into the vanilla game experience.

description:
CuratedShips

.zip download

Hello

This mod adds some ships focused on fitting in with the vanilla game.

This was initially a mod of me stealing specific ships I liked from other mods and adding them to this one with tweaks, hence the name. Currently contains only ships I've made/kitbashed.

Ships:

Spoiler
Viper-class Frigate (w/LG variant)

Cheap midline frigate with maneuvering jets and a built-in missile autoloader. LG variant swaps the ballistics for energies.

Wisp-class Phase Tender (Frigate)

Frigate-sized phase tender, unarmed and very expensive for how much it can carry, but difficult to catch and equiped with shielded cargo holds.

Kebero-class Frigate

An expensive and somewhat undergunned (for its price) phase skimming frigate, but with fantastic agility and flux stats.

Cataphract-class Heavy Frigate

Transitionary low-tech design with damper field and a shield generator. Fast, great survivability, costs as much as expensive high-tech frigates to deploy.

Diaphane-class Exploration Ship (Destroyer)

Barely armed, down-sized Apogee, has a flight-deck and a built-in efficiency overhaul, but not much else.

Spirit-class Command Destroyer

Built-in operations center with a full flight-deck and PD drone system which is unused in vanilla, but still in vanilla files. Few mounts, but can fit a decent missile loadout.

Auxilia-class Light Battlecarrier (Destroyer, w/XIV variant)

A mini-Legion with two fighter-bays, much better fighter-bay efficiency than the Legion, but far less direct firepower, retains the Legion's slightly different mounts for the XIV variant.

(This ship used to be cruiser-sized in this mod, but has been reworked into a destroyer as of v3)

Valravn-class Light Cruiser

Large ballistic hardpoint with an accelerated ammo feeder system, but somewhat slow with poor defenses; great when the system is up, lackluster without it.

Erinyes-class Light Cruiser

A phase skimming light-cruiser with a large energy hardpoint, has flux and survivability problems, very much just a big wolf.

Roc-class Carrier

Four fighter bays with built in recovery shuttles and the Reserve Deployment ship system. Even with the system up it only matches the Condor in terms of fighter bay/DP efficiency, but is a good ship for using carrier bonuses from officers.

(FYI, because the Persean League uses carriers infrequently and I didn't want to change vanilla game files, this is a somewhat rare ship to find.)

Nausicaa-class Battlecruiser

High-tech battlecruiser with an energy bolt coherer, but no large mounts of any kind. Plasma Jets ship system, essentially a capital-sized Aurora.

Kestros Support Fighter

Heavy support fighter armed with two fighter swarmers and a fighter variant of the thumper which has 62% of the regular thumper's burst dps, but 100% of its sustained dps (both without expanded mags).

If, for some reason, you want to steal any of these and tweak them, please feel free.
Thanks to the people who made the ship editor program, and the ship/weapon pack creator whose forum formatting I stole.

aiDescription: Introduces a variety of new vessels, including frigates, destroyers, cruisers, and battlecruisers. These ships feature unique systems like phase skimming, specialized flight decks, and distinct weapon loadouts. The collection aims to provide balanced additions that complement the existing vanilla fleet without altering core game files.
